newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet fuel diffs near steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet fuel diffs near steady in thin trade.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel differentials showed little movement Tuesday, while the NYMEX basis price firmed modestly.
May NYMEX heating oil futures settled up 0.18 cent on the day.
New York Harbor prompt 54-grade jet fuel changed hands at 3.85 cents over the screen, near unchanged versus Monday levels, traders said.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade for 12th cycle delivery on the Colonial Pipeline was talked between 0.50 and 0.75 cent over the screen, also near flat with the previous day.
